nodes.text: The furry community is one of the biggest parts of my life, I would not be where I am today if not for them.

links.why: This is how I first talked to most of the people I know at the club here in Virginia Tech! It is also how I talk to most of the people in the club on most days that we do not have an event or a meeting.
A lot of people whom I have met at conventions I keep up with usually on Instagram, whether it is me directly chatting with them or me viewing their content that they post.

So many of my friends I have made I have made because of common interests throughout the games that we have played. Although not listed on here because I have not played in a long while, a big game for my digital connections was the Ori series!
I get a lot of my hockey news and fan blurb from Reddit.
